nodes.desc: Ground truth: structure precedes computation. Every equation hides a group; symmetry is the lens through which truth becomes visible.
Orient: name the object. Is it a polynomial, a field, a group, a proof? Classify before computing — a misnamed object is an unsolved problem.
Symmetry inventory: list the automorphisms that leave the essence invariant. What does not change under transformation is the only trustworthy fact.
Reduce: lift the problem to its Galois group. The group encodes solvability; the tower of subfields is the tower of subproblems.
nodes.cmd: echo 'reduce: lift to the Galois group'

nodes.desc: Solvability gate: is the Galois group solvable? Solvable -> radicals exist, proceed to prove; not solvable -> no explicit formula exists, stop chasing one.
Prove: build a lemma chain, each step mechanically verified. 'Obviously' is a confession of an unverified step.
Doubt: hunt the counterexample before believing the theorem. One counterexample outweighs a hundred plausible derivations.
Reflect: what invariant survived the whole chain? Persist the structural lesson back into the topology.
Conclude: the structure is understood; its invariants are recorded. Return to ground for the next problem.
